# Dad GIFs

> A clean dad humor hub: dad jokes by category, jokes for kids, a guide to writing puns, Father's Day gift ideas and an explainer on dad memes and GIF culture.

Dad GIFs is an editorial humor site. All jokes are family-friendly. The site uses only original SVG and CSS artwork, not copyrighted GIFs, and gift ideas are brand-free categories.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dadgifs.com/): Overview with featured jokes, links to every collection and guide, and a dad humor FAQ.
- [The Best Dad Jokes, Sorted by Category](https://dadgifs.com/best-dad-jokes): Over 60 clean, groan-worthy dad jokes on food, animals, science, work, sports and more.
- [Dad Jokes for Kids: Clean, Silly and School-Safe](https://dadgifs.com/dad-jokes-for-kids): School jokes, animal jokes, knock-knocks and riddles for kids, plus tips for joke-telling together.
- [How to Write Dad Puns (and Deliver Them Shamelessly)](https://dadgifs.com/how-to-write-dad-puns): The types of puns, a simple formula for making your own, and how to deliver them for maximum groan.
- [Father’s Day Gift Ideas for Every Kind of Dad](https://dadgifs.com/fathers-day-gift-ideas): Gift categories for every kind of dad and budget, plus when Father's Day falls around the world.
- [Dad Memes and GIF Culture, Explained](https://dadgifs.com/dad-memes-and-gif-culture): A short history of the GIF, how dad memes work, and how to share GIFs legally and accessibly.
